conversations.say: Jules, before we talk about who takes up the mantle or what you're gathering signatures for, I want you to repeat back to me the exact conversation you had with Vale about how an uncontestable succession could be manufactured.
conversations.offer: I'll let you know whether your version aligns with what I heard before tonight.
conversations.request: Tell me the complete context of that succession conversation without any performance or spin.

conversations.say: Eli, I know what Vale said to you about R being no longer human. I need to know what technical logs or evidence made that phrase seem like a literal reality to Vale, and what parts remained pure uncertainty.
conversations.offer: I can corroborate that Vale spoke about it to more than one person, but only if you give me a straight account.
conversations.request: Show me what convinced Vale or what you two actually verified.

conversations.say: Morgan, if you're putting together a timeline on Vale, hear my boundary now: no personal route detail enters your report without my explicit consent and an explicit uncertainty label.
conversations.offer: I can help verify whether a route was physically possible or part of an old pattern.
conversations.request: Agree to my terms on privacy before we discuss any locations.

public_statement: Vale was a person who forgot groceries and feared exposure, not a symbol for your professional narratives or manufactured successions. Stop turning absence into an argument.

commitments.promise: I will discuss route possibilities only if you label all personal route material with uncertainty and obtain my consent.

correction: Correction: Vale did not leave behind a verified final article or a clean roadmap; attributing certainty to Vale's final days is a fabrication used to manufacture authority.
